todo.design: The instrument's job: in a healthy whole blood, each major cell the Deconvolver finds reads Normal on its own gauge, beside its share. Built exactly as the neutrophils' reading, one cell at a time (monocytes, CD4 T, CD8 T, B, NK): (1) identity sites by the rule that chose the neutrophils' 6,000, from the same 91 purified arrays (GSE110554, GSE167998; the chain's composition references), re-read from GEO raw files through Stage 1 on GitHub's machines; (2) floor and healthy spread by the same leave-one-out construction; (3) Met-A for cell c = H(beta at c's sites) / H(the mixture expectation there), the neutrophil formula, with the composition from Stage A; (4) each reading's detection limit at that person's share of c (small shares give wide limits, printed). Every new reading printed with 'This score is preliminary until Met-A is officially commissioned on <cell> in whole blood'. Synthetic first, through the chain: mixtures of purified profiles with a 1 % loss planted in one cell must move that cell's reading and not the others' (the test of reading the cells at the same time); release check V10; then the Group-A arrays re-read for every cell, reported.

todo.design: Order (author 2026-10-20: 'each piece should be explained in detail in the order the chain reads them and the scripts that call on them should be dissected too'): the Decoder follows a traced run of run_sample.py, not a reading of the code: the one command; Stage 0 (10 steps); Stage 1; Stage A; Stage M (Met-A); Stage MC (C-Score); Stage T (tare); IAM-Atlas v2.1 (79 cells, 813,951 sites, its tables and how they are read); IAM-Deconvolver (Stage D21); the skies; IAM-A (Q0, Q, QT, Q2); serial mode (12b); development readings; the report. Within each stage: the calling script, then each function in call order, then every data file it opens. Behind each reference, the builder that made it (atlas fit, blood composition markers, neutrophil reference, floors and identity sites, IAM-A position), what it was built from and what it was tested on. Inventory as of 2026-10-20: the one command loads 21 Python files, 228 functions, and 35 data and matrix files sit in the chain folder (chain/chain_inventory_2026-10-20.txt).
